description:
Find Trustpilot companies by name or domain; returns their domains for the other tools.

        An exact domain returns that company. Cost: 1 credit per call (also when nothing
        matches); each call returns one results page, the next page is a new call.

        Args:
            query: Company name or domain, e.g. 'zalando' or 'zalando.it'.
            limit: Results to return, 1-10 (default 10).
            cursor: `next_cursor` from a previous call to get more results (1 credit).
name: search_companies
title: Search companies
